hints: Use the segment area formula $A = \frac{1}{2}r^2(\theta - \sin\theta)$ with $\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3}$.
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of the circular segment bounded by chord $AB$ and arc $AB$:
$$A = \text{Area of sector} - \text{Area of } \triangle OAB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right) - \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)$$

Factorise and evaluate the constant multiplier:
$$A = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \left(\frac{2\pi}{3} - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) = r^2 \left(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\right) \approx r^2 (1.04720 - 0.43301) = 0.61418 r^2 \approx 0.614 r^2\text{ cm}^2$$

hints: Apply the chain rule $\frac{dA}{dt} = \frac{dA}{dr} \times \frac{dr}{dt}$ with $r = 20$ and $\frac{dr}{dt} = 0.4$.
walkthrough:
Differentiate $A = \left(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\right) r^2 \approx 0.61418 r^2$ with respect to $r$:
$$\frac{dA}{dr} = 2 \left(\frac{\pi}{3} - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}\right) r \approx 1.22837 r$$

Apply the chain rule for rate of change:
$$\frac{dA}{dt} = \frac{dA}{dr} \times \frac{dr}{dt} = (1.22837 r) \times (0.4)$$

Substitute $r = 20\text{ cm}$ and round to 2 significant figures:
$$\frac{dA}{dt} = 1.22837 \times 20 \times 0.4 = 9.827 \approx 9.8\text{ cm}^2\text{ s}^{-1}$$

hints: Differentiate with respect to time using $\frac{dl}{dt} = \frac{dl}{dr} \times \frac{dr}{dt}$.
walkthrough:
Write the formula for arc length $l$ subtending an angle $\frac{2\pi}{3}\text{ rad}$:
$$l = r\theta = \frac{2\pi}{3} r$$

Differentiate with respect to time $t$:
$$\frac{dl}{dt} = \frac{2\pi}{3} \frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{2\pi}{3} (0.4) = \frac{0.8\pi}{3} \approx 0.8378\text{ cm s}^{-1}$$

Round to 2 significant figures:
$$\frac{dl}{dt} \approx 0.84\text{ cm s}^{-1}$$
